style.backgroundSystem: seamless porcelain card planes #FBF6EE for the standing screens, milk-glaze sweep #F2E7D5 for the benefit and wearing screens, and one supporting deeper warm riser band #EACFB6 used only as a banded field for the proof, annotation, variant and split screens; the field stays sculptural and matte, never painted; no gradients, no scenery, no tiled grid, no dark closing surface
style.direction: soft-lit warm makeup-tool vanity commerce with blank proof furniture
style.iconSystem: dashed contour overlays tracing the product's own facets, fully-rounded lozenge tags with one leading dot in #BE8C84, hairline bracket rules closed by a single centred downward tick, one S-curve terrain split, blank unnumbered proof-cell grids, soft-cornered photographic thumbnails and one vertical side-rail label; no circular magnifier viewport, no numbered circle, no curved connector arc, no seal ring, no offset solid rectangle, no hollow square marker, no oblique-cut band, no radial fan guide, no filled pictogram
style.lightingSystem: warm beauty wrap light from one large softened top diffusion source with a gentle bounce on the far side, near-shadowless throughout, only tight contact shadows under each base, one small controlled specular allowed on a wet edge, never a long cast shadow and never a rim flare
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft-lit warm makeup-tool vanity commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of milk-glaze field #F2E7D5, porcelain card #FBF6EE, coffee-brown type #4A3626 and one dusty-rose accent #BE8C84, with a single supporting deeper warm riser band #EACFB6 reserved for banded screens; warm beauty wrap light from one large softened top diffusion source with a gentle bounce, near-shadowless, tight contact shadows only, never a long cast shadow; one light humanist sans-serif with a wide-tracked uppercase Latin kicker rail set above every Chinese headline; components limited to dashed facet contours, fully-rounded lozenge tags with a leading rose dot, hairline bracket rules closed by one centred downward tick, one S-curve terrain split, blank unnumbered proof grids, soft-cornered photo thumbnails and one vertical side-rail label; stable product scale, silhouette and cut-plane orientation with the shape and colour supplied only by the injected reference; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no hard long shadows, no circular magnifier viewports, no numbered circles, no curved connector arcs, no seal rings, no offset solid rectangles, no hollow square markers, no oblique-cut bands, no palette-knife pigment swipes, no dark closing surface, no invented figures.
noDrift: no colour palette changes and no dark closing surface
no mixed fonts and no serif display
no hard directional key with long cast shadows
no borrowed components: no magnifier circles, numbered circles, connector arcs, seal rings, offset rectangles, square step markers or oblique-cut bands
no product redesign: shape, colour and finish come only from the injected reference
no invented figures: no press counts, expansion ratios, pore readings, weights, sizes, hygiene or certification claims
style.presentationRules: the unit keeps one identical scale, silhouette and cut-plane orientation on every screen, standing on its broad flat facet or lying on the same baseline pair; the sectioned twin is the only staging variant; all human imagery is a generic cheek-and-jaw crop or a relaxed hand only, with no eyes toward camera and no readable identity; every colour well stays an empty uncoloured placeholder tone supplied by the injected reference and is never named, numbered or hex-pinned
style.surfaceSystem: smooth matte warm board in #F2E7D5 and #FBF6EE with a very fine even grain, plus one granular pressed-powder bed and one smooth wet-sheen plane used only as the two halves of the S-curve split; no marble, no wood plank, no stone slab, no fabric, no palette-knife pigment swipe, no combed paste ridge
style.typography: one light humanist sans-serif family, Chinese copy always set as 「」-bracketed placeholders, and a wide-tracked uppercase Latin kicker rail placed above every Chinese headline as the set signature; heading 30-36pt, sub-label 16-20pt, label 13-14pt, micro Latin line 9-10pt; no dense body text, no serif or handwritten mixing
